summary: GDS Holdings, a Cayman-incorporated, Shanghai-based data center operator listed on NASDAQ (GDS) and HKEX (9698), furnished a Form 6-K containing two exhibits dated November 11–12, 2026. Exhibit 99.1 is a press release advising that third quarter 2026 unaudited results will be published after the Hong Kong close and before the U.S. open on November 25, 2026, with a management call at 7:00 AM ET. Exhibit 99.2 is the Hong Kong exchange announcement of the board meeting date. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor or structural terms are disclosed; the filing is routine earnings-calendar disclosure. Watch the November 25 print for guidance and DayOne minority-interest commentary.
